#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an A0 portrait academic poster on LLMs in Medicine."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap
import os

# A0 portrait at 150 DPI (841×1189mm → 4967×7016 px)
WIDTH = 4967
HEIGHT = 7016
DPI = 150

# Color palette
NAVY = (18, 32, 64)
DARK_NAVY = (12, 22, 48)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (245, 247, 250)
MID_GRAY = (220, 225, 232)
TEAL = (70, 150, 160)
DARK_TEAL = (45, 120, 130)
STEEL_BLUE = (100, 130, 170)
AMBER = (230, 140, 50)
CORAL = (210, 80, 70)
SOFT_NAVY = (40, 60, 100)
RISK_BG = (255, 248, 245)
FRAMEWORK_BG = (240, 248, 250)

# Fonts
FONT_SANS_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_SANS = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
FONT_SERIF = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf"
FONT_SERIF_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf"

def load_font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

img = Image.new('RGB', (WIDTH, HEIGHT), WHITE)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

MARGIN_X = 200
CONTENT_WIDTH = WIDTH - 2 * MARGIN_X
COL_GAP = 100
COL_WIDTH = (CONTENT_WIDTH - COL_GAP) // 2

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
def wrap_text(text, font, max_width):
    """Word-wrap text to fit within max_width pixels."""
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current_line = ""
    for word in words:
        test_line = f"{current_line} {word}".strip()
        if font.getlength(test_line) <= max_width:
            current_line = test_line
        else:
            if current_line:
                lines.append(current_line)
            current_line = word
    if current_line:
        lines.append(current_line)
    return lines

def draw_text_block(x, y, text, font, fill, max_width, line_spacing=1.4):
    """Draw wrapped text block, return y position after."""
    lines = wrap_text(text, font, max_width)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        bbox = font.getbbox(line)
        h = (bbox[3] - bbox[1]) if bbox else 40
        y += int(h * line_spacing)
    return y

def draw_section_header(x, y, title, accent=TEAL):
    """Draw section title with accent bar."""
    draw.rectangle([(x, y + 4), (x + 70, y + 12)], fill=accent)
    y += 28
    font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 64)
    draw.text((x, y), title, font=font, fill=NAVY)
    y += 95
    return y

def draw_bullet_item(x, y, bold_part, rest_part, max_width, bullet_color=TEAL):
    """Draw a bullet point with bold prefix and regular continuation."""
    font_bold = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)
    font_reg = load_font(FONT_SANS, 36)

    # Bullet circle
    draw.ellipse([(x + 2, y + 12), (x + 18, y + 28)], fill=bullet_color)
    text_x = x + 38

    available_width = max_width - 38

    # Render first line: bold part then as much regular text as fits
    bold_w = font_bold.getlength(bold_part)

    # Wrap the regular text to fill remaining space on first line and subsequent lines
    full_text = bold_part + rest_part
    # Use a character-based estimate for wrapping
    avg_char = font_reg.getlength("n")
    chars_per_line = int(available_width / avg_char)

    all_lines = textwrap.wrap(full_text, width=chars_per_line)

    for i, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if i == 0:
            # Draw bold prefix
            draw.text((text_x, y), bold_part, font=font_bold, fill=NAVY)
            # Draw the rest of the first line in regular
            rest_of_line = line[len(bold_part):]
            rest_x = text_x + bold_w
            draw.text((rest_x, y), rest_of_line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        else:
            draw.text((text_x, y), line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        y += 54
    return y + 12

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
header_h = 620
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (WIDTH, header_h)], fill=NAVY)

title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 136)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 120), "Large Language Models in Medicine", font=title_font, fill=WHITE)

subtitle_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 78)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 285), "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward", font=subtitle_font, fill=TEAL)

conf_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 46)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 420), "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024", font=conf_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

cite_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 40)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 500), "Based on comprehensive review  \u2022  Nature Medicine, July 2023  \u2022  500+ peer-reviewed studies", font=cite_font, fill=STEEL_BLUE)

# Accent line
draw.rectangle([(0, header_h), (WIDTH, header_h + 10)], fill=TEAL)

# ============================================================
# METRICS CARDS
# ============================================================
metrics_y = header_h + 60
card_gap = 50
card_w = (CONTENT_WIDTH - 3 * card_gap) // 4
card_h = 300

metrics = [
    {  "value": ">90%", "label": "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
       "line1": "Exceeded passing threshold",
       "line2": "on all 3 exam steps", "accent": TEAL},
    {  "value": "500+", "label": "Publications in 2023",
       "line1": "Peer-reviewed papers on",
       "line2": "LLMs in medicine", "accent": STEEL_BLUE},
    {  "value": "Up to 30%", "label": "Hallucination Rate",
       "line1": "Fabricated medical info",
       "line2": "in LLM outputs", "accent": CORAL},
    {  "value": "$10.5B", "label": "Projected Market 2030",
       "line1": "Global healthcare",
       "line2": "LLM market size", "accent": TEAL},
]

for i, m in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN_X + i * (card_w + card_gap)
    cy = metrics_y + 30

    # Card with rounded corners
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(cx, cy), (cx + card_w, cy + card_h)],
        radius=18, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, outline=MID_GRAY, width=2
    )
    # Top accent
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(cx, cy), (cx + card_w, cy + 12)],
        radius=6, fill=m["accent"]
    )

    # Value
    vfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 80)
    draw.text((cx + 35, cy + 35), m["value"], font=vfont, fill=m["accent"])

    # Label
    lfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)
    draw.text((cx + 35, cy + 140), m["label"], font=lfont, fill=NAVY)

    # Context lines
    cfont = load_font(FONT_SANS, 30)
    draw.text((cx + 35, cy + 195), m["line1"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
    draw.text((cx + 35, cy + 235), m["line2"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

# Separator line
sep_y = metrics_y + card_h + 90
draw.rectangle([(MARGIN_X, sep_y), (WIDTH - MARGIN_X, sep_y + 3)], fill=MID_GRAY)

# ============================================================
# BODY — LEFT COLUMN
# ============================================================
body_y = sep_y + 50
lx = MARGIN_X
ly = body_y

# --- Overview ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "What Are LLMs & Why Do They Matter?")
body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 37)
overview = (
    "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have "
    "rapidly entered the healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities "
    "in understanding and generating medical text. These foundation models \u2014 trained "
    "on vast corpora of text data \u2014 are poised to reshape clinical practice, "
    "biomedical research, and medical education. The pace of adoption has been "
    "extraordinary, with over 500 peer-reviewed publications in 2023 alone."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, overview, body_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ly += 55

# --- Applications ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Key Clinical & Research Applications")

apps = [
    ("Clinical Documentation: ", "Automated note generation, discharge summaries \u2014 Pilot deployments"),
    ("Diagnostic Support: ", "Differential diagnosis, radiology interpretation \u2014 Research stage"),
    ("Patient Communication: ", "Answering questions, simplifying jargon \u2014 Early adoption"),
    ("Medical Education: ", "Exam prep, case-based learning, AI tutoring \u2014 Active use"),
    ("Biomedical Research: ", "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation \u2014 Emerging"),
]
for bold, rest in apps:
    ly = draw_bullet_item(lx, ly, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, TEAL)
ly += 55

# --- Performance ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Performance Benchmarks & Evidence")

# Bar chart
bar_x = lx + 20
bar_w = COL_WIDTH - 60
bar_h = 52

perf = [
    ("GPT-4", 92, ">90%", TEAL),
    ("Med-PaLM 2", 86.5, "86.5%", STEEL_BLUE),
    ("GPT-3.5", 60, "~60%", (160, 170, 185)),
]

label_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 35)
score_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 32)

for name, pct, label, color in perf:
    # Name
    draw.text((bar_x, ly), name, font=label_font, fill=NAVY)
    ly += 46

    # Bar background
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=8, fill=LIGHT_GRAY
    )
    # Bar fill
    fill_w = int(bar_w * pct / 100)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + fill_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=8, fill=color
    )
    # Score
    draw.text((bar_x + fill_w + 15, ly + 8), label, font=score_font, fill=NAVY)
    ly += bar_h + 30

# Passing threshold annotation
threshold_x = bar_x + int(bar_w * 60 / 100)
thresh_top = body_y + 730  # approximate
# Draw from current position
ann_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 28)
draw.text((bar_x, ly + 5), "\u25B6 Passing threshold: ~60%", font=ann_font, fill=AMBER)
ly += 55

# Performance note
note_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 34)
note = (
    "These results demonstrate substantial medical knowledge encoding. However, "
    "performance on real-world clinical scenarios remains less well characterized. "
    "Multiple-choice benchmarks may overestimate real-world clinical utility."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, note, note_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 40

# Key insight box at bottom of left column
insight_y = ly + 20
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(lx, insight_y), (lx + COL_WIDTH, insight_y + 180)],
    radius=16, fill=(240, 245, 255), outline=STEEL_BLUE, width=3
)
ins_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)
draw.text((lx + 30, insight_y + 25), "The Central Tension", font=ins_font, fill=NAVY)
ins_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 34)
draw.text((lx + 30, insight_y + 75), "Benchmark success (\u226590%) does not guarantee", font=ins_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 30, insight_y + 120), "clinical safety. The 30% hallucination rate demands", font=ins_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 30, insight_y + 165), "rigorous validation before deployment.", font=ins_body, fill=CORAL)


# ============================================================
# BODY — RIGHT COLUMN
# ============================================================
rx = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP
ry = body_y

# --- Risks ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Risks, Limitations & Ethical Concerns", CORAL)

# Warning callout box
warn_h = 180
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + warn_h)],
    radius=16, fill=RISK_BG, outline=CORAL, width=4
)
warn_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 42)
warn_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 38)
draw.text((rx + 35, ry + 25), "\u26A0  Critical Gap", font=warn_title, fill=CORAL)
draw.text((rx + 35, ry + 80), "Benchmark performance: >90%", font=warn_body, fill=NAVY)
draw.text((rx + 35, ry + 128), "Hallucination rate: up to 30%", font=warn_body, fill=CORAL)
ry += warn_h + 35

risks = [
    ("Hallucinations: ", "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information, including fake citations. Up to 30% error rate in medical Q&A."),
    ("Bias & Equity: ", "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases in training data, leading to disparities in care recommendations across demographics."),
    ("Privacy Concerns: ", "Patient data in prompts may be transmitted to external servers, raising HIPAA and GDPR compliance issues."),
    ("Lack of Validation: ", "Most evaluations use multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical trials."),
    ("Over-reliance Risk: ", "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical appraisal."),
]
for bold, rest in risks:
    ry = draw_bullet_item(rx, ry, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, CORAL)
ry += 50

# --- Framework ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Framework for Responsible Deployment", DARK_TEAL)

# Framework box
fw_items = [
    ("1.", "Rigorous Prospective Evaluation", "Diverse clinical settings before any deployment"),
    ("2.", "Human-in-the-Loop Design", "Clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs"),
    ("3.", "Transparent Reporting", "Model limitations, training data, known failure modes"),
    ("4.", "Equity Audits", "Differential performance across patient populations"),
    ("5.", "Regulatory Alignment", "FDA, EMA, WHO guidance on AI-based medical devices"),
]

fw_h = len(fw_items) * 130 + 40
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + fw_h)],
    radius=18, fill=FRAMEWORK_BG, outline=TEAL, width=3
)

fw_title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 38)
fw_body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 34)
fw_num_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 42)

fy = ry + 30
for num, title, desc in fw_items:
    # Number circle
    draw.ellipse([(rx + 30, fy + 5), (rx + 70, fy + 45)], fill=DARK_TEAL)
    num_w = fw_num_font.getlength(num)
    draw.text((rx + 50 - num_w/2, fy + 4), num, font=fw_num_font, fill=WHITE)

    # Title
    draw.text((rx + 90, fy + 5), title, font=fw_title_font, fill=DARK_TEAL)
    # Description
    draw.text((rx + 90, fy + 55), desc, font=fw_body_font, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

    # Separator (except last)

        fy += 110
        draw.line([(rx + 30, fy), (rx + COL_WIDTH - 30, fy)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=1)
        fy += 20
    else:
        fy += 110

# ============================================================
# FOOTER
# ============================================================
footer_y = HEIGHT - 180
draw.rectangle([(0, footer_y), (WIDTH, HEIGHT)], fill=DARK_NAVY)

    fill_w = int(bar_w * pct / 100)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + fill_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=10, fill=color
    )
    draw.text((bar_x + fill_w + 18, ly + 12), label, font=score_font, fill=color)
    ly += bar_h + 40

# Threshold line annotation
threshold_x = bar_x + int(bar_w * 60 / 100)
ann_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 30)
draw.rectangle([(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + 2)], fill=MID_GRAY)
draw.text((threshold_x - 10, ly + 10), "\u25B2 Passing threshold (~60%)", font=ann_font, fill=AMBER)
ly += 60

# Performance note
note_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 36)
note = (
    "These results demonstrate substantial medical knowledge encoding. However, "
    "performance on real-world clinical scenarios remains less well characterized, "
    "and multiple-choice benchmarks may overestimate clinical utility."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, note, note_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 60

# Central tension box
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(lx, ly), (lx + COL_WIDTH, ly + 240)],
    radius=18, fill=(245, 248, 255), outline=STEEL_BLUE, width=4
)
tens_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 42)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 28), "The Central Tension", font=tens_title, fill=NAVY)
tens_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 37)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 88), "Benchmark success (\u226590%) does not guarantee", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 138), "clinical safety. The up-to-30% hallucination", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 188), "rate demands rigorous validation before deployment.", font=tens_body, fill=CORAL)

# ============================================================
rx = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP
ry = body_y

# --- Risks ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Risks, Limitations & Ethical Concerns", CORAL)

# Warning callout
warn_h = 210
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + warn_h)],
    radius=18, fill=RISK_BG, outline=CORAL, width=4
)
warn_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 46)
warn_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 40)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 28), "\u26A0  Critical Gap", font=warn_title, fill=CORAL)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 90), "Benchmark performance:  >90%", font=warn_body, fill=NAVY)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 145), "Hallucination rate:  up to 30%", font=warn_body, fill=CORAL)
ry += warn_h + 45

risks = [
    ("Hallucinations: ", "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information, including fake citations. Studies report up to 30% error rate in medical Q&A tasks."),
    ("Bias & Equity: ", "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in training data, leading to disparities in care recommendations across demographic groups."),
    ("Privacy Concerns: ", "Patient data used in prompts may be transmitted to external servers, raising serious HIPAA and GDPR compliance concerns."),
    ("Lack of Clinical Validation: ", "Most LLM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical trials in real settings."),
    ("Over-reliance Risk: ", "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical appraisal of accuracy."),
]
for bold, rest in risks:
    ry = draw_bullet_item(rx, ry, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, CORAL, 38)
ry += 80

ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Framework for Responsible Deployment", DARK_TEAL)

# Intro text
fw_intro_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 36)
fw_intro = "A multi-stakeholder framework for safe integration of LLMs into clinical practice:"
ry = draw_text_block(rx, ry, fw_intro, fw_intro_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ry += 30

fw_items = [
    ("1", "Rigorous Prospective Evaluation", "Diverse clinical settings before any deployment"),
    ("2", "Human-in-the-Loop Design", "Clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs"),
    ("3", "Transparent Reporting", "Model limitations, training data sources, known failure modes"),
    ("4", "Equity Audits", "Assess differential performance across patient populations"),
    ("5", "Regulatory Alignment", "FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on AI-based medical devices"),
]

fw_h = len(fw_items) * 140 + 60
draw.rounded_rectangle(

    radius=20, fill=FRAMEWORK_BG, outline=TEAL, width=3
)

fw_title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 40)
fw_body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 35)
fw_num_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)

fy = ry + 35
for num, title, desc in fw_items:
    # Number circle
    draw.ellipse([(rx + 35, fy + 2), (rx + 78, fy + 45)], fill=DARK_TEAL)
    nw = fw_num_font.getlength(num)
    draw.text((rx + 56 - nw / 2, fy + 6), num, font=fw_num_font, fill=WHITE)

    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 2), title, font=fw_title_font, fill=DARK_TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 55), desc, font=fw_body_font, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

    if num != "5":
        fy += 120
        draw.line([(rx + 35, fy), (rx + COL_WIDTH - 35, fy)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=1)
        fy += 20
    else:
        fy += 120

ry_after_fw = ry + fw_h + 50

concl = (
    "The consensus is clear: LLMs hold transformative potential for medicine, "
    "but their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust "
    "governance to ensure patient safety."
)
draw_text_block(rx, ry_after_fw, concl, concl_font, NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.5)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an A0 portrait academic poster on LLMs in Medicine."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap
import os

# A0 portrait at 150 DPI (841×1189mm → 4967×7016 px)
WIDTH = 4967
HEIGHT = 7016
DPI = 150

# Color palette
NAVY = (18, 32, 64)
DARK_NAVY = (12, 22, 48)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (245, 247, 250)
MID_GRAY = (220, 225, 232)
TEAL = (70, 150, 160)
DARK_TEAL = (45, 120, 130)
STEEL_BLUE = (100, 130, 170)
AMBER = (230, 140, 50)
CORAL = (210, 80, 70)
SOFT_NAVY = (40, 60, 100)
RISK_BG = (255, 248, 245)
FRAMEWORK_BG = (238, 247, 249)

FONT_SANS_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_SANS = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
FONT_SERIF = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf"
FONT_SERIF_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf"

def load_font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

img = Image.new('RGB', (WIDTH, HEIGHT), WHITE)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

MARGIN_X = 220
CONTENT_WIDTH = WIDTH - 2 * MARGIN_X
COL_GAP = 120
COL_WIDTH = (CONTENT_WIDTH - COL_GAP) // 2

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
def wrap_text(text, font, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if font.getlength(test) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines

def draw_text_block(x, y, text, font, fill, max_width, line_spacing=1.5):
    lines = wrap_text(text, font, max_width)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        bbox = font.getbbox(line)
        h = (bbox[3] - bbox[1]) if bbox else 42
        y += int(h * line_spacing)
    return y

def draw_section_header(x, y, title, accent=TEAL):
    draw.rectangle([(x, y + 4), (x + 80, y + 14)], fill=accent)
    y += 32
    font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 68)
    draw.text((x, y), title, font=font, fill=NAVY)
    y += 105
    return y

def draw_bullet_item(x, y, bold_part, rest_part, max_width, bullet_color=TEAL, font_size=38):
    font_bold = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, font_size)
    font_reg = load_font(FONT_SANS, font_size)

    draw.ellipse([(x + 2, y + 14), (x + 20, y + 32)], fill=bullet_color)
    text_x = x + 42
    available_width = max_width - 42

    bold_w = font_bold.getlength(bold_part)
    full_text = bold_part + rest_part
    avg_char = font_reg.getlength("n")
    chars_per_line = int(available_width / avg_char)
    all_lines = textwrap.wrap(full_text, width=chars_per_line)

    for i, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if i == 0:
            draw.text((text_x, y), bold_part, font=font_bold, fill=NAVY)
            rest_of_line = line[len(bold_part):]
            rest_x = text_x + bold_w
            draw.text((rest_x, y), rest_of_line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        else:
            draw.text((text_x, y), line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        y += int(font_size * 1.6)
    return y + 18

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
header_h = 680
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (WIDTH, header_h)], fill=NAVY)

# Subtle gradient overlay at bottom of header
for i in range(60):
    alpha = i / 60
    r = int(18 + (70 - 18) * alpha * 0.3)
    g = int(32 + (150 - 32) * alpha * 0.3)
    b = int(64 + (160 - 64) * alpha * 0.3)
    draw.line([(0, header_h - 60 + i), (WIDTH, header_h - 60 + i)], fill=(r, g, b))

title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 142)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 130), "Large Language Models", font=title_font, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 290), "in Medicine", font=title_font, fill=WHITE)

subtitle_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 82)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 460), "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward", font=subtitle_font, fill=TEAL)

conf_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 44)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 580), "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  \u2022  Based on Nature Medicine, July 2023", font=conf_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

# Accent line
draw.rectangle([(0, header_h), (WIDTH, header_h + 12)], fill=TEAL)

# ============================================================
# METRICS CARDS
# ============================================================
metrics_y = header_h + 70
card_gap = 55
card_w = (CONTENT_WIDTH - 3 * card_gap) // 4
card_h = 330

metrics = [
    {"value": ">90%", "label": "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
     "line1": "Exceeded passing threshold",
     "line2": "on all 3 exam steps", "accent": TEAL},
    {"value": "500+", "label": "Publications in 2023",
     "line1": "Peer-reviewed papers on",
     "line2": "LLMs in medicine", "accent": STEEL_BLUE},
    {"value": "Up to 30%", "label": "Hallucination Rate",
     "line1": "Fabricated medical info",
     "line2": "in LLM outputs", "accent": CORAL},
    {"value": "$10.5B", "label": "Projected Market 2030",
     "line1": "Global healthcare",
     "line2": "LLM market size", "accent": TEAL},
]

for i, m in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN_X + i * (card_w + card_gap)
    cy = metrics_y

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(cx, cy), (cx + card_w, cy + card_h)],
        radius=20, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, outline=MID_GRAY, width=2
    )
    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([(cx + 1, cy + 1), (cx + card_w - 1, cy + 14)], fill=m["accent"])

    vfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 88)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 45), m["value"], font=vfont, fill=m["accent"])

    lfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 38)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 160), m["label"], font=lfont, fill=NAVY)

    cfont = load_font(FONT_SANS, 32)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 215), m["line1"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 258), m["line2"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

# Separator
sep_y = metrics_y + card_h + 70
draw.rectangle([(MARGIN_X, sep_y), (WIDTH - MARGIN_X, sep_y + 3)], fill=MID_GRAY)

# ============================================================
# LEFT COLUMN
# ============================================================
body_y = sep_y + 70
lx = MARGIN_X
ly = body_y

# --- Overview ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "What Are LLMs & Why Do They Matter?")
body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 40)
overview = (
    "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have "
    "rapidly entered the healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities "
    "in understanding and generating medical text. These foundation models \u2014 trained "
    "on vast corpora of text data \u2014 are poised to reshape clinical practice, "
    "biomedical research, and medical education."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, overview, body_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)

# Additional context
ly += 20
context_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 36)
ctx_text = (
    "The pace of adoption has been extraordinary: over 500 peer-reviewed "
    "publications appeared in 2023, and the global healthcare LLM market "
    "is projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, ctx_text, context_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ly += 70

# --- Applications ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Key Clinical & Research Applications")

apps = [
    ("Clinical Documentation: ", "Automated note generation, discharge summaries \u2014 Pilot deployments in major health systems"),
    ("Diagnostic Support: ", "Differential diagnosis generation, radiology report interpretation \u2014 Research stage"),
    ("Patient Communication: ", "Answering patient questions, simplifying medical jargon \u2014 Early adoption"),
    ("Medical Education: ", "Exam preparation, case-based learning, AI-powered tutoring \u2014 Active use"),
    ("Biomedical Research: ", "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, protocol drafting \u2014 Emerging"),
]
for bold, rest in apps:
    ly = draw_bullet_item(lx, ly, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, TEAL, 38)
ly += 30

# Adoption note
adopt_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 35)
adopt_text = (
    "Clinical documentation and patient-facing communication tools have seen "
    "the fastest real-world adoption, with several health systems integrating "
    "LLM-powered assistants into electronic health records."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, adopt_text, adopt_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 80

# --- Performance ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Performance Benchmarks & Evidence")

bar_x = lx + 20
bar_w = COL_WIDTH - 80
bar_h = 62

perf = [
    ("GPT-4", 92, ">90%", TEAL),
    ("Med-PaLM 2", 86.5, "86.5%", STEEL_BLUE),
    ("GPT-3.5", 60, "~60%", (160, 170, 185)),
]

label_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 38)
score_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 34)

for name, pct, label, color in perf:
    draw.text((bar_x, ly), name, font=label_font, fill=NAVY)
    ly += 52
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=10, fill=LIGHT_GRAY
    )
    fill_w = int(bar_w * pct / 100)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + fill_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=10, fill=color
    )
    draw.text((bar_x + fill_w + 18, ly + 12), label, font=score_font, fill=color)
    ly += bar_h + 40

# Threshold line annotation
threshold_x = bar_x + int(bar_w * 60 / 100)
ann_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 30)
draw.rectangle([(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + 2)], fill=MID_GRAY)
draw.text((threshold_x - 10, ly + 10), "\u25B2 Passing threshold (~60%)", font=ann_font, fill=AMBER)
ly += 60

# Performance note
note_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 36)
note = (
    "These results demonstrate substantial medical knowledge encoding. However, "
    "performance on real-world clinical scenarios remains less well characterized, "
    "and multiple-choice benchmarks may overestimate clinical utility."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, note, note_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 60

# Central tension box
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(lx, ly), (lx + COL_WIDTH, ly + 240)],
    radius=18, fill=(245, 248, 255), outline=STEEL_BLUE, width=4
)
tens_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 42)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 28), "The Central Tension", font=tens_title, fill=NAVY)
tens_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 37)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 88), "Benchmark success (\u226590%) does not guarantee", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 138), "clinical safety. The up-to-30% hallucination", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 188), "rate demands rigorous validation before deployment.", font=tens_body, fill=CORAL)

# ============================================================
# RIGHT COLUMN
# ============================================================
rx = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP
ry = body_y

# --- Risks ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Risks, Limitations & Ethical Concerns", CORAL)

# Warning callout
warn_h = 210
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + warn_h)],
    radius=18, fill=RISK_BG, outline=CORAL, width=4
)
warn_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 46)
warn_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 40)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 28), "\u26A0  Critical Gap", font=warn_title, fill=CORAL)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 90), "Benchmark performance:  >90%", font=warn_body, fill=NAVY)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 145), "Hallucination rate:  up to 30%", font=warn_body, fill=CORAL)
ry += warn_h + 45

risks = [
    ("Hallucinations: ", "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information, including fake citations. Studies report up to 30% error rate in medical Q&A tasks."),
    ("Bias & Equity: ", "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in training data, leading to disparities in care recommendations across demographic groups."),
    ("Privacy Concerns: ", "Patient data used in prompts may be transmitted to external servers, raising serious HIPAA and GDPR compliance concerns."),
    ("Lack of Clinical Validation: ", "Most LLM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical trials in real settings."),
    ("Over-reliance Risk: ", "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical appraisal of accuracy."),
]
for bold, rest in risks:
    ry = draw_bullet_item(rx, ry, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, CORAL, 38)
ry += 80

# --- Framework ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Framework for Responsible Deployment", DARK_TEAL)

# Intro text
fw_intro_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 36)
fw_intro = "A multi-stakeholder framework for safe integration of LLMs into clinical practice:"
ry = draw_text_block(rx, ry, fw_intro, fw_intro_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ry += 30

fw_items = [
    ("1", "Rigorous Prospective Evaluation", "Diverse clinical settings before any deployment"),
    ("2", "Human-in-the-Loop Design", "Clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs"),
    ("3", "Transparent Reporting", "Model limitations, training data sources, known failure modes"),
    ("4", "Equity Audits", "Assess differential performance across patient populations"),

]

fw_h = len(fw_items) * 140 + 60
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + fw_h)],
    radius=20, fill=FRAMEWORK_BG, outline=TEAL, width=3
)

fw_title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 40)
fw_body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 35)
fw_num_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)

fy = ry + 35
for num, title, desc in fw_items:
    # Number circle
    draw.ellipse([(rx + 35, fy + 2), (rx + 78, fy + 45)], fill=DARK_TEAL)
    nw = fw_num_font.getlength(num)
    draw.text((rx + 56 - nw / 2, fy + 6), num, font=fw_num_font, fill=WHITE)

    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 2), title, font=fw_title_font, fill=DARK_TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 55), desc, font=fw_body_font, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

    if num != "5":
        fy += 120
        draw.line([(rx + 35, fy), (rx + COL_WIDTH - 35, fy)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=1)
        fy += 20
    else:
        fy += 120

# Conclusion text below framework
ry_after_fw = ry + fw_h + 50
concl_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF_BOLD, 38)
concl = (
    "The consensus is clear: LLMs hold transformative potential for medicine, "
    "but their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust "
    "governance to ensure patient safety."
)
draw_text_block(rx, ry_after_fw, concl, concl_font, NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.5)

# ============================================================
# FOOTER
# ============================================================
footer_y = HEIGHT - 200
draw.rectangle([(0, footer_y), (WIDTH, HEIGHT)], fill=DARK_NAVY)

footer_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)
draw.text(
    (MARGIN_X, footer_y + 45),
    "Key Takeaway: LLMs hold transformative potential for medicine, but deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust governance.",
    font=footer_font, fill=TEAL
)
cite2_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 30)
draw.text(
    (MARGIN_X, footer_y + 110),
    "Source: Nature Medicine, July 2023  \u2022  Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  \u2022  Academic dissemination poster",
    font=cite2_font, fill=MID_GRAY
)

# Column divider
div_x = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP // 2
draw.line([(div_x, body_y), (div_x, footer_y - 80)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", dpi=(DPI, DPI), quality=95)
print(f"Poster saved: /app/output/final_poster.png ({WIDTH}x{HEIGHT} px @ {DPI} DPI)")

tool_use_result.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an A0 portrait academic poster on LLMs in Medicine."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap
import os

# A0 portrait at 150 DPI (841×1189mm → 4967×7016 px)
WIDTH = 4967
HEIGHT = 7016
DPI = 150

# Color palette
NAVY = (18, 32, 64)
DARK_NAVY = (12, 22, 48)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (245, 247, 250)
MID_GRAY = (220, 225, 232)
TEAL = (70, 150, 160)
DARK_TEAL = (45, 120, 130)
STEEL_BLUE = (100, 130, 170)
AMBER = (230, 140, 50)
CORAL = (210, 80, 70)
SOFT_NAVY = (40, 60, 100)
RISK_BG = (255, 248, 245)
FRAMEWORK_BG = (238, 247, 249)

FONT_SANS_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_SANS = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
FONT_SERIF = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf"
FONT_SERIF_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf"

def load_font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

img = Image.new('RGB', (WIDTH, HEIGHT), WHITE)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

MARGIN_X = 220
CONTENT_WIDTH = WIDTH - 2 * MARGIN_X
COL_GAP = 120
COL_WIDTH = (CONTENT_WIDTH - COL_GAP) // 2

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
def wrap_text(text, font, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if font.getlength(test) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines

def draw_text_block(x, y, text, font, fill, max_width, line_spacing=1.5):
    lines = wrap_text(text, font, max_width)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        bbox = font.getbbox(line)
        h = (bbox[3] - bbox[1]) if bbox else 42
        y += int(h * line_spacing)
    return y

def draw_section_header(x, y, title, accent=TEAL):
    draw.rectangle([(x, y + 4), (x + 80, y + 14)], fill=accent)
    y += 32
    font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 68)
    draw.text((x, y), title, font=font, fill=NAVY)
    y += 105
    return y

def draw_bullet_item(x, y, bold_part, rest_part, max_width, bullet_color=TEAL, font_size=38):
    font_bold = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, font_size)
    font_reg = load_font(FONT_SANS, font_size)

    draw.ellipse([(x + 2, y + 14), (x + 20, y + 32)], fill=bullet_color)
    text_x = x + 42
    available_width = max_width - 42

    bold_w = font_bold.getlength(bold_part)
    full_text = bold_part + rest_part
    avg_char = font_reg.getlength("n")
    chars_per_line = int(available_width / avg_char)
    all_lines = textwrap.wrap(full_text, width=chars_per_line)

    for i, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if i == 0:
            draw.text((text_x, y), bold_part, font=font_bold, fill=NAVY)
            rest_of_line = line[len(bold_part):]
            rest_x = text_x + bold_w
            draw.text((rest_x, y), rest_of_line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        else:
            draw.text((text_x, y), line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        y += int(font_size * 1.6)
    return y + 18

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
header_h = 680
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (WIDTH, header_h)], fill=NAVY)

# Subtle gradient overlay at bottom of header
for i in range(60):
    alpha = i / 60
    r = int(18 + (70 - 18) * alpha * 0.3)
    g = int(32 + (150 - 32) * alpha * 0.3)
    b = int(64 + (160 - 64) * alpha * 0.3)
    draw.line([(0, header_h - 60 + i), (WIDTH, header_h - 60 + i)], fill=(r, g, b))

title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 142)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 130), "Large Language Models", font=title_font, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 290), "in Medicine", font=title_font, fill=WHITE)

subtitle_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 82)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 460), "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward", font=subtitle_font, fill=TEAL)

conf_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 44)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 580), "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  \u2022  Based on Nature Medicine, July 2023", font=conf_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

# Accent line
draw.rectangle([(0, header_h), (WIDTH, header_h + 12)], fill=TEAL)

# ============================================================
# METRICS CARDS
# ============================================================
metrics_y = header_h + 70
card_gap = 55
card_w = (CONTENT_WIDTH - 3 * card_gap) // 4
card_h = 330

metrics = [
    {"value": ">90%", "label": "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
     "line1": "Exceeded passing threshold",
     "line2": "on all 3 exam steps", "accent": TEAL},
    {"value": "500+", "label": "Publications in 2023",
     "line1": "Peer-reviewed papers on",
     "line2": "LLMs in medicine", "accent": STEEL_BLUE},
    {"value": "Up to 30%", "label": "Hallucination Rate",
     "line1": "Fabricated medical info",
     "line2": "in LLM outputs", "accent": CORAL},
    {"value": "$10.5B", "label": "Projected Market 2030",
     "line1": "Global healthcare",
     "line2": "LLM market size", "accent": TEAL},
]

for i, m in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN_X + i * (card_w + card_gap)
    cy = metrics_y

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(cx, cy), (cx + card_w, cy + card_h)],
        radius=20, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, outline=MID_GRAY, width=2
    )
    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([(cx + 1, cy + 1), (cx + card_w - 1, cy + 14)], fill=m["accent"])

    vfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 88)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 45), m["value"], font=vfont, fill=m["accent"])

    lfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 38)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 160), m["label"], font=lfont, fill=NAVY)

    cfont = load_font(FONT_SANS, 32)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 215), m["line1"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 258), m["line2"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

# Separator
sep_y = metrics_y + card_h + 70
draw.rectangle([(MARGIN_X, sep_y), (WIDTH - MARGIN_X, sep_y + 3)], fill=MID_GRAY)

# ============================================================
# LEFT COLUMN
# ============================================================
body_y = sep_y + 70
lx = MARGIN_X
ly = body_y

# --- Overview ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "What Are LLMs & Why Do They Matter?")
body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 40)
overview = (
    "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have "
    "rapidly entered the healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities "
    "in understanding and generating medical text. These foundation models \u2014 trained "
    "on vast corpora of text data \u2014 are poised to reshape clinical practice, "
    "biomedical research, and medical education."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, overview, body_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)

# Additional context
ly += 20
context_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 36)
ctx_text = (
    "The pace of adoption has been extraordinary: over 500 peer-reviewed "
    "publications appeared in 2023, and the global healthcare LLM market "
    "is projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, ctx_text, context_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ly += 70

# --- Applications ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Key Clinical & Research Applications")

apps = [
    ("Clinical Documentation: ", "Automated note generation, discharge summaries \u2014 Pilot deployments in major health systems"),
    ("Diagnostic Support: ", "Differential diagnosis generation, radiology report interpretation \u2014 Research stage"),
    ("Patient Communication: ", "Answering patient questions, simplifying medical jargon \u2014 Early adoption"),
    ("Medical Education: ", "Exam preparation, case-based learning, AI-powered tutoring \u2014 Active use"),
    ("Biomedical Research: ", "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, protocol drafting \u2014 Emerging"),
]
for bold, rest in apps:
    ly = draw_bullet_item(lx, ly, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, TEAL, 38)
ly += 30

# Adoption note
adopt_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 35)
adopt_text = (
    "Clinical documentation and patient-facing communication tools have seen "
    "the fastest real-world adoption, with several health systems integrating "
    "LLM-powered assistants into electronic health records."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, adopt_text, adopt_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 80

# --- Performance ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Performance Benchmarks & Evidence")

bar_x = lx + 20
bar_w = COL_WIDTH - 80
bar_h = 62

perf = [
    ("GPT-4", 92, ">90%", TEAL),
    ("Med-PaLM 2", 86.5, "86.5%", STEEL_BLUE),
    ("GPT-3.5", 60, "~60%", (160, 170, 185)),
]

label_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 38)
score_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 34)

for name, pct, label, color in perf:
    draw.text((bar_x, ly), name, font=label_font, fill=NAVY)
    ly += 52
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=10, fill=LIGHT_GRAY
    )
    fill_w = int(bar_w * pct / 100)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + fill_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=10, fill=color
    )
    draw.text((bar_x + fill_w + 18, ly + 12), label, font=score_font, fill=color)
    ly += bar_h + 40

# Threshold line annotation
threshold_x = bar_x + int(bar_w * 60 / 100)
ann_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 30)
draw.rectangle([(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + 2)], fill=MID_GRAY)
draw.text((threshold_x - 10, ly + 10), "\u25B2 Passing threshold (~60%)", font=ann_font, fill=AMBER)
ly += 60

# Performance note
note_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 36)
note = (
    "These results demonstrate substantial medical knowledge encoding. However, "
    "performance on real-world clinical scenarios remains less well characterized, "
    "and multiple-choice benchmarks may overestimate clinical utility."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, note, note_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 60

# Central tension box
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(lx, ly), (lx + COL_WIDTH, ly + 240)],
    radius=18, fill=(245, 248, 255), outline=STEEL_BLUE, width=4
)
tens_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 42)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 28), "The Central Tension", font=tens_title, fill=NAVY)
tens_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 37)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 88), "Benchmark success (\u226590%) does not guarantee", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 138), "clinical safety. The up-to-30% hallucination", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 188), "rate demands rigorous validation before deployment.", font=tens_body, fill=CORAL)

# ============================================================
# RIGHT COLUMN
# ============================================================
rx = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP
ry = body_y

# --- Risks ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Risks, Limitations & Ethical Concerns", CORAL)

# Warning callout
warn_h = 210
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + warn_h)],
    radius=18, fill=RISK_BG, outline=CORAL, width=4
)
warn_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 46)
warn_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 40)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 28), "\u26A0  Critical Gap", font=warn_title, fill=CORAL)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 90), "Benchmark performance:  >90%", font=warn_body, fill=NAVY)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 145), "Hallucination rate:  up to 30%", font=warn_body, fill=CORAL)
ry += warn_h + 45

risks = [
    ("Hallucinations: ", "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information, including fake citations. Studies report up to 30% error rate in medical Q&A tasks."),
    ("Bias & Equity: ", "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in training data, leading to disparities in care recommendations across demographic groups."),
    ("Privacy Concerns: ", "Patient data used in prompts may be transmitted to external servers, raising serious HIPAA and GDPR compliance concerns."),
    ("Lack of Clinical Validation: ", "Most LLM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical trials in real settings."),
    ("Over-reliance Risk: ", "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical appraisal of accuracy."),
]
for bold, rest in risks:
    ry = draw_bullet_item(rx, ry, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, CORAL, 38)
ry += 80

# --- Framework ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Framework for Responsible Deployment", DARK_TEAL)

# Intro text
fw_intro_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 36)
fw_intro = "A multi-stakeholder framework for safe integration of LLMs into clinical practice:"
ry = draw_text_block(rx, ry, fw_intro, fw_intro_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ry += 30

fw_items = [
    ("1", "Rigorous Prospective Evaluation", "Diverse clinical settings before any deployment"),
    ("2", "Human-in-the-Loop Design", "Clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs"),
    ("3", "Transparent Reporting", "Model limitations, training data sources, known failure modes"),
    ("4", "Equity Audits", "Assess differential performance across patient populations"),
    ("5", "Regulatory Alignment", "FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on AI-based medical devices"),
]

fw_h = len(fw_items) * 140 + 60
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + fw_h)],
    radius=20, fill=FRAMEWORK_BG, outline=TEAL, width=3
)

fw_title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 40)
fw_body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 35)
fw_num_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)

fy = ry + 35
for num, title, desc in fw_items:
    # Number circle
    draw.ellipse([(rx + 35, fy + 2), (rx + 78, fy + 45)], fill=DARK_TEAL)
    nw = fw_num_font.getlength(num)
    draw.text((rx + 56 - nw / 2, fy + 6), num, font=fw_num_font, fill=WHITE)

    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 2), title, font=fw_title_font, fill=DARK_TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 55), desc, font=fw_body_font, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

    if num != "5":
        fy += 120
        draw.line([(rx + 35, fy), (rx + COL_WIDTH - 35, fy)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=1)
        fy += 20
    else:
        fy += 120

# Conclusion text below framework
ry_after_fw = ry + fw_h + 50
concl_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF_BOLD, 38)
concl = (
    "The consensus is clear: LLMs hold transformative potential for medicine, "
    "but their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust "
    "governance to ensure patient safety."
)
draw_text_block(rx, ry_after_fw, concl, concl_font, NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.5)

# ============================================================
# FOOTER
# ============================================================
footer_y = HEIGHT - 200
draw.rectangle([(0, footer_y), (WIDTH, HEIGHT)], fill=DARK_NAVY)

footer_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)
draw.text(
    (MARGIN_X, footer_y + 45),
    "Key Takeaway: LLMs hold transformative potential for medicine, but deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust governance.",
    font=footer_font, fill=TEAL
)
cite2_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 30)
draw.text(
    (MARGIN_X, footer_y + 110),
    "Source: Nature Medicine, July 2023  \u2022  Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  \u2022  Academic dissemination poster",
    font=cite2_font, fill=MID_GRAY
)

# Column divider
div_x = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP // 2
draw.line([(div_x, body_y), (div_x, footer_y - 80)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", dpi=(DPI, DPI), quality=95)
print(f"Poster saved: /app/output/final_poster.png ({WIDTH}x{HEIGHT} px @ {DPI} DPI)")

raw_arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an A0 portrait academic poster on LLMs in Medicine."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap
import os

# A0 portrait at 150 DPI (841×1189mm → 4967×7016 px)
WIDTH = 4967
HEIGHT = 7016
DPI = 150

# Color palette
NAVY = (18, 32, 64)
DARK_NAVY = (12, 22, 48)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (245, 247, 250)
MID_GRAY = (220, 225, 232)
TEAL = (70, 150, 160)
DARK_TEAL = (45, 120, 130)
STEEL_BLUE = (100, 130, 170)
AMBER = (230, 140, 50)
CORAL = (210, 80, 70)
SOFT_NAVY = (40, 60, 100)
RISK_BG = (255, 248, 245)
FRAMEWORK_BG = (238, 247, 249)

FONT_SANS_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_SANS = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
FONT_SERIF = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf"
FONT_SERIF_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf"

def load_font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

img = Image.new('RGB', (WIDTH, HEIGHT), WHITE)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

MARGIN_X = 220
CONTENT_WIDTH = WIDTH - 2 * MARGIN_X
COL_GAP = 120
COL_WIDTH = (CONTENT_WIDTH - COL_GAP) // 2

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
def wrap_text(text, font, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if font.getlength(test) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines

def draw_text_block(x, y, text, font, fill, max_width, line_spacing=1.5):
    lines = wrap_text(text, font, max_width)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        bbox = font.getbbox(line)
        h = (bbox[3] - bbox[1]) if bbox else 42
        y += int(h * line_spacing)
    return y

def draw_section_header(x, y, title, accent=TEAL):
    draw.rectangle([(x, y + 4), (x + 80, y + 14)], fill=accent)
    y += 32
    font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 68)
    draw.text((x, y), title, font=font, fill=NAVY)
    y += 105
    return y

def draw_bullet_item(x, y, bold_part, rest_part, max_width, bullet_color=TEAL, font_size=38):
    font_bold = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, font_size)
    font_reg = load_font(FONT_SANS, font_size)

    draw.ellipse([(x + 2, y + 14), (x + 20, y + 32)], fill=bullet_color)
    text_x = x + 42
    available_width = max_width - 42

    bold_w = font_bold.getlength(bold_part)
    full_text = bold_part + rest_part
    avg_char = font_reg.getlength("n")
    chars_per_line = int(available_width / avg_char)
    all_lines = textwrap.wrap(full_text, width=chars_per_line)

    for i, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if i == 0:
            draw.text((text_x, y), bold_part, font=font_bold, fill=NAVY)
            rest_of_line = line[len(bold_part):]
            rest_x = text_x + bold_w
            draw.text((rest_x, y), rest_of_line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        else:
            draw.text((text_x, y), line, font=font_reg, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
        y += int(font_size * 1.6)
    return y + 18

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
header_h = 680
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (WIDTH, header_h)], fill=NAVY)

# Subtle gradient overlay at bottom of header
for i in range(60):
    alpha = i / 60
    r = int(18 + (70 - 18) * alpha * 0.3)
    g = int(32 + (150 - 32) * alpha * 0.3)
    b = int(64 + (160 - 64) * alpha * 0.3)
    draw.line([(0, header_h - 60 + i), (WIDTH, header_h - 60 + i)], fill=(r, g, b))

title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 142)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 130), "Large Language Models", font=title_font, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 290), "in Medicine", font=title_font, fill=WHITE)

subtitle_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 82)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 460), "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward", font=subtitle_font, fill=TEAL)

conf_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 44)
draw.text((MARGIN_X, 580), "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  \u2022  Based on Nature Medicine, July 2023", font=conf_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

# Accent line
draw.rectangle([(0, header_h), (WIDTH, header_h + 12)], fill=TEAL)

# ============================================================
# METRICS CARDS
# ============================================================
metrics_y = header_h + 70
card_gap = 55
card_w = (CONTENT_WIDTH - 3 * card_gap) // 4
card_h = 330

metrics = [
    {"value": ">90%", "label": "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
     "line1": "Exceeded passing threshold",
     "line2": "on all 3 exam steps", "accent": TEAL},
    {"value": "500+", "label": "Publications in 2023",
     "line1": "Peer-reviewed papers on",
     "line2": "LLMs in medicine", "accent": STEEL_BLUE},
    {"value": "Up to 30%", "label": "Hallucination Rate",
     "line1": "Fabricated medical info",
     "line2": "in LLM outputs", "accent": CORAL},
    {"value": "$10.5B", "label": "Projected Market 2030",
     "line1": "Global healthcare",
     "line2": "LLM market size", "accent": TEAL},
]

for i, m in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN_X + i * (card_w + card_gap)
    cy = metrics_y

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(cx, cy), (cx + card_w, cy + card_h)],
        radius=20, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, outline=MID_GRAY, width=2
    )
    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([(cx + 1, cy + 1), (cx + card_w - 1, cy + 14)], fill=m["accent"])

    vfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 88)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 45), m["value"], font=vfont, fill=m["accent"])

    lfont = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 38)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 160), m["label"], font=lfont, fill=NAVY)

    cfont = load_font(FONT_SANS, 32)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 215), m["line1"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 258), m["line2"], font=cfont, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

# Separator
sep_y = metrics_y + card_h + 70
draw.rectangle([(MARGIN_X, sep_y), (WIDTH - MARGIN_X, sep_y + 3)], fill=MID_GRAY)

# ============================================================
# LEFT COLUMN
# ============================================================
body_y = sep_y + 70
lx = MARGIN_X
ly = body_y

# --- Overview ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "What Are LLMs & Why Do They Matter?")
body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 40)
overview = (
    "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have "
    "rapidly entered the healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities "
    "in understanding and generating medical text. These foundation models \u2014 trained "
    "on vast corpora of text data \u2014 are poised to reshape clinical practice, "
    "biomedical research, and medical education."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, overview, body_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)

# Additional context
ly += 20
context_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 36)
ctx_text = (
    "The pace of adoption has been extraordinary: over 500 peer-reviewed "
    "publications appeared in 2023, and the global healthcare LLM market "
    "is projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, ctx_text, context_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ly += 70

# --- Applications ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Key Clinical & Research Applications")

apps = [
    ("Clinical Documentation: ", "Automated note generation, discharge summaries \u2014 Pilot deployments in major health systems"),
    ("Diagnostic Support: ", "Differential diagnosis generation, radiology report interpretation \u2014 Research stage"),
    ("Patient Communication: ", "Answering patient questions, simplifying medical jargon \u2014 Early adoption"),
    ("Medical Education: ", "Exam preparation, case-based learning, AI-powered tutoring \u2014 Active use"),
    ("Biomedical Research: ", "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, protocol drafting \u2014 Emerging"),
]
for bold, rest in apps:
    ly = draw_bullet_item(lx, ly, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, TEAL, 38)
ly += 30

# Adoption note
adopt_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 35)
adopt_text = (
    "Clinical documentation and patient-facing communication tools have seen "
    "the fastest real-world adoption, with several health systems integrating "
    "LLM-powered assistants into electronic health records."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, adopt_text, adopt_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 80

# --- Performance ---
ly = draw_section_header(lx, ly, "Performance Benchmarks & Evidence")

bar_x = lx + 20
bar_w = COL_WIDTH - 80
bar_h = 62

perf = [
    ("GPT-4", 92, ">90%", TEAL),
    ("Med-PaLM 2", 86.5, "86.5%", STEEL_BLUE),
    ("GPT-3.5", 60, "~60%", (160, 170, 185)),
]

label_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 38)
score_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 34)

for name, pct, label, color in perf:
    draw.text((bar_x, ly), name, font=label_font, fill=NAVY)
    ly += 52
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=10, fill=LIGHT_GRAY
    )
    fill_w = int(bar_w * pct / 100)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + fill_w, ly + bar_h)],
        radius=10, fill=color
    )
    draw.text((bar_x + fill_w + 18, ly + 12), label, font=score_font, fill=color)
    ly += bar_h + 40

# Threshold line annotation
threshold_x = bar_x + int(bar_w * 60 / 100)
ann_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 30)
draw.rectangle([(bar_x, ly), (bar_x + bar_w, ly + 2)], fill=MID_GRAY)
draw.text((threshold_x - 10, ly + 10), "\u25B2 Passing threshold (~60%)", font=ann_font, fill=AMBER)
ly += 60

# Performance note
note_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF, 36)
note = (
    "These results demonstrate substantial medical knowledge encoding. However, "
    "performance on real-world clinical scenarios remains less well characterized, "
    "and multiple-choice benchmarks may overestimate clinical utility."
)
ly = draw_text_block(lx, ly, note, note_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.45)
ly += 60

# Central tension box
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(lx, ly), (lx + COL_WIDTH, ly + 240)],
    radius=18, fill=(245, 248, 255), outline=STEEL_BLUE, width=4
)
tens_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 42)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 28), "The Central Tension", font=tens_title, fill=NAVY)
tens_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 37)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 88), "Benchmark success (\u226590%) does not guarantee", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 138), "clinical safety. The up-to-30% hallucination", font=tens_body, fill=SOFT_NAVY)
draw.text((lx + 35, ly + 188), "rate demands rigorous validation before deployment.", font=tens_body, fill=CORAL)

# ============================================================
# RIGHT COLUMN
# ============================================================
rx = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP
ry = body_y

# --- Risks ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Risks, Limitations & Ethical Concerns", CORAL)

# Warning callout
warn_h = 210
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + warn_h)],
    radius=18, fill=RISK_BG, outline=CORAL, width=4
)
warn_title = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 46)
warn_body = load_font(FONT_SANS, 40)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 28), "\u26A0  Critical Gap", font=warn_title, fill=CORAL)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 90), "Benchmark performance:  >90%", font=warn_body, fill=NAVY)
draw.text((rx + 40, ry + 145), "Hallucination rate:  up to 30%", font=warn_body, fill=CORAL)
ry += warn_h + 45

risks = [
    ("Hallucinations: ", "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information, including fake citations. Studies report up to 30% error rate in medical Q&A tasks."),
    ("Bias & Equity: ", "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in training data, leading to disparities in care recommendations across demographic groups."),
    ("Privacy Concerns: ", "Patient data used in prompts may be transmitted to external servers, raising serious HIPAA and GDPR compliance concerns."),
    ("Lack of Clinical Validation: ", "Most LLM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical trials in real settings."),
    ("Over-reliance Risk: ", "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical appraisal of accuracy."),
]
for bold, rest in risks:
    ry = draw_bullet_item(rx, ry, bold, rest, COL_WIDTH, CORAL, 38)
ry += 80

# --- Framework ---
ry = draw_section_header(rx, ry, "Framework for Responsible Deployment", DARK_TEAL)

# Intro text
fw_intro_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 36)
fw_intro = "A multi-stakeholder framework for safe integration of LLMs into clinical practice:"
ry = draw_text_block(rx, ry, fw_intro, fw_intro_font, SOFT_NAVY, COL_WIDTH)
ry += 30

fw_items = [
    ("1", "Rigorous Prospective Evaluation", "Diverse clinical settings before any deployment"),
    ("2", "Human-in-the-Loop Design", "Clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs"),
    ("3", "Transparent Reporting", "Model limitations, training data sources, known failure modes"),
    ("4", "Equity Audits", "Assess differential performance across patient populations"),
    ("5", "Regulatory Alignment", "FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on AI-based medical devices"),
]

fw_h = len(fw_items) * 140 + 60
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    [(rx, ry), (rx + COL_WIDTH, ry + fw_h)],
    radius=20, fill=FRAMEWORK_BG, outline=TEAL, width=3
)

fw_title_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 40)
fw_body_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 35)
fw_num_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)

fy = ry + 35
for num, title, desc in fw_items:
    # Number circle
    draw.ellipse([(rx + 35, fy + 2), (rx + 78, fy + 45)], fill=DARK_TEAL)
    nw = fw_num_font.getlength(num)
    draw.text((rx + 56 - nw / 2, fy + 6), num, font=fw_num_font, fill=WHITE)

    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 2), title, font=fw_title_font, fill=DARK_TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 100, fy + 55), desc, font=fw_body_font, fill=SOFT_NAVY)

    if num != "5":
        fy += 120
        draw.line([(rx + 35, fy), (rx + COL_WIDTH - 35, fy)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=1)
        fy += 20
    else:
        fy += 120

# Conclusion text below framework
ry_after_fw = ry + fw_h + 50
concl_font = load_font(FONT_SERIF_BOLD, 38)
concl = (
    "The consensus is clear: LLMs hold transformative potential for medicine, "
    "but their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust "
    "governance to ensure patient safety."
)
draw_text_block(rx, ry_after_fw, concl, concl_font, NAVY, COL_WIDTH, line_spacing=1.5)

# ============================================================
# FOOTER
# ============================================================
footer_y = HEIGHT - 200
draw.rectangle([(0, footer_y), (WIDTH, HEIGHT)], fill=DARK_NAVY)

footer_font = load_font(FONT_SANS_BOLD, 36)
draw.text(
    (MARGIN_X, footer_y + 45),
    "Key Takeaway: LLMs hold transformative potential for medicine, but deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust governance.",
    font=footer_font, fill=TEAL
)
cite2_font = load_font(FONT_SANS, 30)
draw.text(
    (MARGIN_X, footer_y + 110),
    "Source: Nature Medicine, July 2023  \u2022  Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  \u2022  Academic dissemination poster",
    font=cite2_font, fill=MID_GRAY
)

# Column divider
div_x = MARGIN_X + COL_WIDTH + COL_GAP // 2
draw.line([(div_x, body_y), (div_x, footer_y - 80)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", dpi=(DPI, DPI), quality=95)
print(f"Poster saved: /app/output/final_poster.png ({WIDTH}x{HEIGHT} px @ {DPI} DPI)")
